source.title: Biohub Cell Tracking - Classical Baseline
source.retrieval: Current public Kaggle source pulled on 2026-09-11; web listing identified it as version 10 of 10 and Apache-2.0 licensed.

static_audit.detector: XY block-mean x4, Gaussian smoothing, Otsu/robust relative threshold, 3D local maxima, full-resolution intensity-weighted centroid refinement and 4 um physical NMS.
static_audit.linker: Two-pass one-to-one Hungarian: 7 um tight raw-displacement gate, then 11 um full gate for leftovers, with half-weight predecessor velocity in assignment cost.
static_audit.topology: Divisions disabled by default; isolated predicted nodes removed.
static_audit.validation: Optional one picked movie per embryo with a custom proxy and Traccuracy panel; not official pooled embryo-disjoint OOF.
static_audit.public_score_context: The current Kaggle page reports 0.763, but this is not local validation evidence.

mechanism_mapping.count_calibration: Optional max_nodes_per_frame is disabled in this exact source; exact count-driven graph selection was independently rejected by EXP198.
mechanism_mapping.motion: Predecessor velocity is closely related to the EXP197 family, which failed nested pooled validation; the notebook adds a tight-then-full assignment schedule but supplies no honest evidence for it.
mechanism_mapping.pruning: Isolated-node/short-component removal overlaps the strongly positive EXP187-190 pruning program already tested with official pooled scoring.
mechanism_mapping.new_candidate: Intensity-weighted centroid refinement plus physical NMS is the main not-yet-isolated mechanism. It requires raw-image inference and should be evaluated only after EXP192 endpoint/association attribution, on a frozen rule and identical detections.

decision: Archive and attribute; do not copy the full notebook, do not promote its score, and do not add another correlated velocity/count sweep before untouched EXP192 confirmation.
